title: Railway RRB Group D Exam City Details 2026
postName: RRB Group D / Level-1 (CEN 09/2025) – Exam City Intimation Slip
vacancyDetails: City intimation slip for Group D CBT Level-1 exam scheduled from 3 August to 21 August 2026
qualification: 10th pass / ITI / National Apprenticeship Certificate as per CEN 09/2025
ageLimit: 18 to 36 years (as per RRB Group D notification; relaxations applicable)
applicationFee: ₹250 (UR/OBC/EWS); ₹0 for SC/ST/PwBD/Female/Transgender (refund rules as per CEN)
documentsRequired: Registration number and DOB/password; photo ID on exam day with admit card
howToApply:
1. Visit https://rrb.digialm.com or regional RRB site
2. Open Group D City Intimation Slip login
3. Enter Registration Number and Password (DOB DD/MM/YYYY)
4. Download city slip for allotted city, date and shift
5. Download full e-Call Letter (admit card) about 4 days before exam
shortDescription: RRB has released Group D Exam City Intimation Slip 2026 for CBT from 3–21 August 2026 (CEN 09/2025). Check city at rrb.digialm.com.
content:
The Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released the Group D Exam City Intimation Slip 2026 for candidates appearing in the Level-1 CBT under CEN 09/2025.

The CBT is scheduled from 3 August to 21 August 2026. City slips for early dates (e.g. 3rd–5th August) have been activated from around 24 July 2026 on rrb.digialm.com.

Important

  • City slip is for travel planning only — it is not the final admit card
  • Full e-Call Letter is usually available about 4 days before the exam
  • Login with Registration Number and DOB password

importantDates.admitCardDate: City slip: from 24 Jul 2026; Admit card ~4 days before exam
